payload.wholeSourceSynopsis: Every great company starts with a simple choice to solve a real problem for people, and you do not need a massive budget, but you do need a clear plan and the courage to start small. Put your product in front of real users right away, listen to what they say, and fix what does not work because success is not about luck; it is about showing up every single day to make your product better.
